name: TanStack Query
summary: Product page for TanStack Query, the library that gives async server state a cache, a lifecycle and declarative fetch/mutate APIs.
description: The landing page for TanStack Query: components declare the data they need while the cache coordinates fetches, subscribers, freshness, retries and background updates, with garbage collection after the last observer leaves. Mutations cover optimistic UI, pending state, recovery, invalidation and reconciliation. Numbers shown on the page: 2.7B total downloads, 88,167,680 weekly downloads and 50,414 GitHub stars; part of the wider TanStack suite (Router, DB, Store, AI, Table …); works with React, Vue, Solid, Svelte, Angular and Lit.
contains: caching, request deduplication, retries, background refetching, window-focus updates and garbage collection
cache lifecycle: fetch, share, revalidate, collect
mutations with optimistic UI, pending state, rollback, invalidation and reconciliation
stats shown: 2.7B total downloads, 88,167,680 weekly downloads, 50,414 GitHub stars
framework adapters: React, Vue, Solid, Svelte, Angular, Lit
part of the TanStack suite: Start, Router, DB, Store, AI, Table, Charts, Form, Virtual and more
